summary: Compiled TikZ reconstruction of the trapezoid-with-apex figure (version 3, best). It has solid trapezoid ABCD (AB, BC, CD, DA) and dashed extensions DE and CE meeting at apex E. Geometry was taken from CV-verified vertices A, B, C, D; E was estimated analytically as the intersection of the leg extensions (~(302, 58) px). The latest critic run gives checklist score 1.0, must_repair=false, and no flaky issues.
